title: Bound priced P104 contact re-pairings across two stages
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Re-pairing up to four contacts over two stages gives no signed BIT gain with symmetric four-pulse preparation, original target body masks, unary diagonal compensation and separable same-port QUERYs. The 173,028-case slice has 153 seam-rank-four cases, all neutral. Both literal 38-root callers replay. The two-port companion finds commuting basis changes in the shared-tag model with the same invoice, and separates that model from the differing physical port-0 and port-1 frames.

## Task and overlap

This is a refined follow-up to [#7852](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7852) at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Exact caller, source preparations and predecessor braid [#7830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830) at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`, [#7952](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7952) at `755fcee748d4e90feda281f27d06e7bc66ecf954`, [#7964](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7964) at `1f90b620855e08b6a941a304ed25eda5600c0deb`, [#7977](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7977) at `92d034719119fcde2f1eeac0a63330d711720e61`. The finite slice and broader contact-graph argument have separate scopes.

## Validation

In a clean Python 3.12 extraction run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and `python3 -I -B verify.py`. This checked the embedded forest and pivot receipts. Use a fresh copy for direct predecessor cold replay because it writes its own receipt.

## Open next questions

Test a charged port-specific physical map or a mixed-port QUERY with changed target bodies. Native frame binding, owned erasure, precision and full admission need separate evidence.

## Credit

Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the original caller, supplier and verifier authors identified in the source notices.
